svg.script: (async()=>{try{const root=new URL('./',location.href);const registration=await navigator.serviceWorker.register(new URL('launcher-sw.js',root),{scope:root.pathname});const worker=registration.installing||registration.waiting||registration.active;if(worker.state!=='activated')await new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{const timer=setTimeout(()=>reject(Error('Connection timed out.')),30000);worker.addEventListener('statechange',()=>{if(worker.state==='activated'){clearTimeout(timer);resolve()}else if(worker.state==='redundant'){clearTimeout(timer);reject(Error('Please reload.'))}})});location.replace(new URL('media-bridge.html'+location.search,root));}catch(error){document.getElementById('status').textContent=error.message;}})();
